hold_text: Promotes RQ-20260930-504 (general short-timeframe strategy discovery, pre-registered, nothing run) out of blocked/ into the queue and ships its instrument scripts/research/short_tf_discovery_sweep.py with 16 tests (statistics, screen -> Bonferroni confirmation -> verdict, subprocess command, per-cell failure).
